entries.name: Straight-Arm Straddle Press to Handstand

source.provenance: Losslessly encoded excerpt of the original human demonstration. Original cadence and decoded dimensions retained; no generated, reversed or composited frames. Audio omitted.

entries.basis: The fixed straight-elbow, no-jump straddle press from grounded feet into a freestanding handstand requires advanced shoulder force, unsupported inverted balance and synchronized hip compression/extension: provisional NM tier 4 in those three tasks. It is mechanically distinct from the existing bent-arm/head-contact press; no hidden added resistance or easier tucked execution is assumed.
entries.trainingConditions: Practice the exact demonstrated skill as clean brief attempts with recovery inside the 45-second opportunity. No uninterrupted hold, repetition target, measured endurance, speed or aerobic tier is inferred. Existing assessments remain unchanged. The press uses floor palms and straight elbows without jumping or head contact.
entries.equipment: Floor palms and feet; no support or head contact.
entries.identity: Straight-elbow no-jump straddle press, distinct from the bent-arm/head-contact press 1705.
